profile.name: Adine Johnson
profile.tagline: Game Designer & Sound Designer attending SCAD
profile.bio: Hello, I am Adine Johnson and I am a junior systems designer student majoring in Game Design at Savannah College of Art and Design (SCAD). I am a lover of all types of games and enjoy playing, studying, and making them in my spare time. I also am very fond of reading, writing, and learning about anything.
profile.quote: The truest form of joy is making others happy
profile.expertise: My goal is to create elegant Game Design and awe-inspiring Sound Design. My core passion lies in the meticulous craft of creating elegant game design, focusing on intuitive mechanics, compelling narratives, and engaging player experiences. Complementing this, I am deeply committed to developing awe-inspiring sound design, where every auditory element is carefully sculpted to enhance immersion, convey emotion, and elevate the overall interactive journey.

portfolioItems.title: Regenesis
portfolioItems.description: A strategy game for 2–4 players where teams of Heroes navigate a chaotic landscape to collect three Fragments of Regenesis and avert global annihilation.

portfolioItems.title: FreezePoint
portfolioItems.description: A collaborative game design and sound design project. FreezePoint combines immersive gameplay mechanics with carefully crafted audio to create a compelling interactive experience.

portfolioItems.title: Wrappers Please
portfolioItems.description: A unique game combining creative game design with immersive sound design elements. Players engage with intuitive mechanics in a fun and engaging environment.

portfolioItems.title: Parking Day SCAD Pro
portfolioItems.description: A SCAD Pro project involving public speaking and website design for Parking Day. Combined design skills with professional presentation to create an impactful community event.

portfolioItems.title: Manacy
portfolioItems.description: An independently developed solo game project showcasing game design skills from concept to completion.

portfolioItems.title: Autonomous Tracker
portfolioItems.description: A solo game project featuring autonomous tracking mechanics and engaging gameplay systems.

portfolioItems.title: Attack of the Crab People
portfolioItems.description: Led a team project creating an exciting game experience. As project lead, managed design direction, team coordination, and overall game development.

portfolioItems.title: 33,333 ft
portfolioItems.description: A solo game project exploring height and scale in game design.

portfolioItems.title: Grime Go Away
portfolioItems.description: A sound design project creating immersive audio landscapes and effects. Every auditory element was carefully sculpted to enhance the overall experience.

workHistory.description: While working as a UI & UX Consultant, I learned how to work in a professional environment and learn on the job to achieve a better result.
While working as a Website Manager, I learned how to deal with unexpected situations and how to prioritize tasks when given multiple jobs to complete.
While working as a Bartender's Assistant, I learned how to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a level of quality and professionalism.
While working as a Higher Pathways Scholar, I was able to share my college experience with rising college freshmen to better prepare them for college.
While working as a Freelance Tutor, I learned how to educate others quickly on complex topics in a professional setting.
